title: An unforced document call at the same moment can clear refreshNext with a stale token
evidence: Origin: S57b adversary finding 2 (PR 1675). In ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts a refused refresh sets refreshNext (:151), and the next adapter call asks for a token with force || this.refreshNext and then clears the flag (:158-159). Two calls run at once: an unforced document call whose token request (:158) was already under way when the flag was set clears it at :159 after its await, though the token it got was the stale one, so the call that needed the forced refresh does not get it. Harmless today: Drive's next record write reads before it uploads, and that read's 401 forces a refresh. Fix later: clear the flag only when this call forced (read it into a local before the await, clear only if it was true), or move the flag onto `current` (:102) so a new adapter carries its own. Checkpoint 4 look-back: the L1 race is this same issue, and takes the same fix: read and clear the flag before the await.
